analytics.name: Analytic 1815
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect User Evasion from documented management, network, or vetting evidence; treat state queries as periodic observations rather than real-time events. Correlate Application State via Android Enterprise / EMM [Managed package inventory/status and package metadata]; OS API Execution via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: App invokes SensorManager.registerListener() for TYPE_ACCELEROMETER or TYPE_GYROSCOPE NOT IN $ApprovedMotionApps$ followed by conditional execution branching correlated with sensor readings — motion sensing followed by behavioral conditiona]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: Correlation window between motion-state inference and subsequent deferred execution
Threshold defining when device motion or interaction is considered low enough to permit hidden execution
Environment-specific set of motion or activity signals used to infer user presence
Baseline of legitimate applications expected to use motion or activity sensing while also conditionally changing behavior
Whether suspiciousness increases when deferred activity starts from background or with no recent foreground interaction
Minimum outbound traffic threshold used to distinguish meaningful deferred operation from benign maintenance traffic
